verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents its own campaign reporting API, including a 'Get campaign report: clicked' endpoint, so per-campaign click data is available. Nothing in the pack covers the rest of the story. Missing for 10: per-campaign opens, unsubscribes and conversions reporting, per-automation-step metrics, time-series/over-time views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time
